decode_minecraft_binary_stream: create a Decoder instance from a file pointer to read Minecraft protocol binary data
read_structured_primitives: use readInt, readLong, or readFloat to parse big-endian binary values from a stream
parse_minecraft_strings: call readString to decode a length-prefixed null-terminated UTF-8 string from binary data
read_minecraft_positions: use readIntPos or readFloatPos to parse 3D coordinate tuples from the binary stream
parse_minecraft_items_and_blocks: call readItem or readBlock to decode item IDs and block types from binary data
